v.why: With edge 0 removed, edge 1 is node 2's only input from the cell input, so a conv there gains more than when node 1 already supplies a path.
A direct skip already supplies a good path to the output, so extra conv capacity on edge 5 saturates.
A strong direct conv path reduces the marginal value of another conv.
Upgrading from 1x1 to 3x3 gives a small gain compared with upgrading from a weak op or none.
Removing a 3x3 conv on edge 0 loses more accuracy than removing a weaker op.
Giving edge 0 any connection beats replacing an existing op with skip.
Pooling over an empty edge adds a path, while replacing a conv with a pool loses accuracy.
Edge 5 is the last link from node 2 to the output, so filling an empty edge with a conv gives a large gain.
Filling an empty direct edge with a conv gains more than swapping another op for 1x1.
Removing a 3x3 conv on an output edge is costlier than removing other ops.
